content.short: Stardust provides a web3 game development API to integrate NFTs into video games and manage players.
content.description: Stardust provides a unified API that lets developers manage players and NFTs within games, making blockchain-enabled game development easier and more scalable. It supports cross-game player scope, streamlined inventories, and flexible token addition or removal for individual players. The system also includes item-creation templates that can be customized or scaled, enabling designers to craft unique in-game items without sacrificing performance or security across a variety of game scenarios, genres, and playstyles.
content.meta: Stardust provides a unified API to manage players and NFTs in games, easing blockchain work. Discover Stardust and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
